texto: The forgetting had fallen over Adam, but the Epinoia of light was hidden inside him.
The first ruler wanted to bring her out of Adam, through his rib.
But the Epinoia of light cannot be grasped.
The darkness chased after her, but it did not catch her.
So he took out a part of the power that was in Adam.
And he shaped another figure, in the form of a woman.
He made her like the Epinoia that had appeared to him.
He put the power he had taken from the man into the woman.
The Savior said, "It was not as Moses said, 'his rib bone.'"
Adam saw the woman beside him.
And in that moment the Epinoia of light appeared.
She lifted the veil that lay over his mind.
And he became sober again, out of the drunkenness of darkness.
He knew his own likeness, and he said, "This is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh."
"So a man will leave his father and his mother, and hold on to his wife."
"And the two of them will be one flesh."
"For his partner will be sent to him, and he will leave his father and his mother."
"Our sister Sophia came down in innocence, to set right what she lacked."
"That is why she was called Life, the mother of the living."
"She was named so by the providence of the power of heaven."
"And through her, they tasted perfect knowledge."
"I came as an eagle on the tree of knowledge, to teach them and to wake them."
"For both of them were fallen, and they knew that they were naked."
"The Epinoia appeared to them as light, and she woke up their thinking."
"Yaldabaoth saw that they had turned away from him, and he cursed his earth."
"He found the woman as she was getting ready for her husband."
"And he made himself lord over her, though he did not know the mystery of the holy plan."
"They were afraid to blame him. And he showed his angels the ignorance that is in him."
"He threw them out of paradise, and he dressed them in gloomy darkness."
"The first ruler saw the virgin who stood beside Adam."
"He saw that the Epinoia of life, bright with light, had appeared in her."
"And Yaldabaoth was full of ignorance."
"But the Providence of the All saw it, and she sent helpers."
"And they snatched Life out of Eve."
"Then the first ruler violated her."
"And in her he fathered two sons: the first is Elohim, and the second is Yave."
"Elohim has the face of a bear. Yave has the face of a cat."
"One is righteous, and the other is unrighteous."
"Yave is the righteous one, and Elohim is the unrighteous one."
"He set Yave over the fire and the wind."
"And he set Elohim over the water and the earth."
"And he called them by the names Cain and Abel, to deceive."
"To this day, the union of the sexes goes on because of the first ruler."
"He planted the desire for begetting in the woman who belongs to Adam."
"Through that union he raised up copies of bodies."
"And he breathed into them from his false spirit."
"He set the two rulers over the powers, so that they would rule over the tomb."
"Then Adam knew the likeness of his own foreknowledge."
"And he fathered the likeness of the Son of Man."
"He called him Seth, after the race that lives in the aeons, the great beings of light."
"In the same way, the Mother sent down her own spirit."
"It is like those in the Fullness. It will prepare a home for the aeons who will come down."
"But the first ruler made them drink the water of forgetting."
"So they would not know where they came from."
"So the seed stayed for a time, and it helped."
"When the Spirit comes down from the holy aeons, he will raise it up and heal what it lacks."
"And so the whole Fullness will become holy, with nothing lacking."
So the ones called Cain and Abel were the ruler's sons, and Seth was the son of Adam.
Next time: the false spirit, the chains of fate, and Noah hidden in a cloud of light.
Thank you for listening to the secret book with me.
